description: Defines core function abstractions for PyTorch JIT, including the Function class, related types, and external references.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a callable function in PyTorch JIT, with schema and execution management.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Invokes the function with given stack and optional keyword arguments, returning an IValue.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Pure virtual method to execute the function with a given stack.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Executes the function asynchronously, returning a future.

methods.name: qualname
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of the function.

methods.name: ensure_defined
methods.description: Ensures the function is defined, possibly by generating its implementation.

methods.name: num_inputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs the function takes.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Defines how different interpreters interact with the function, with overloads for server and mobile interpreters.
